title: DSA Pattern Mastery Tracker — Expanded Final Review
notes: Expanded final-review edition covering the core and many advanced pattern families from the roadmap.
Each listed inner variation has five direct practice links and tracking fields.
Problems may intentionally repeat across patterns because many interview problems combine techniques.
Links are canonical problem-page URLs, but they have not all been live-checked; verify any link that fails to open.
This is a broad interview-focused catalog, not a guarantee of every algorithm ever used in DSA.
